request: Make the existing task-notes app usable on a narrow phone: keep the Add task action visible without horizontal scrolling, reject whitespace-only titles with useful feedback, and preserve adding a valid task and seeing it after reload. Keep the current visual direction.

acceptance.text: At 320px width, the form and Add task action fit without horizontal scrolling.
Whitespace-only input produces Enter a task title feedback and adds no task; valid titles are trimmed.
A valid task can be submitted with the keyboard, receives confirmation, and persists after reload; desktop behavior remains usable.
